summary: Small car park hemmed in by commercial buildings; no homes nearby.
reasons: Surrounded by commercial buildings and trees
Flat, open to the street at the east

best_section.where: Middle of the small car park behind the corner trees

drivers.seclusion: Backed by commercial buildings on the north and west, tree screen to the south; nearest homes are across the road to the south.
drivers.access_and_room: Open gravel and sealed car park with a gap at the east side; about 10 cars parked along the south edge, space for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street on the east; busier road to the south screened by trees.
drivers.convention: Looks like private venue or business parking; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Low-lying: about 8 m elevation, Witton Creek 126 m away
Mapped gate 249 m away has a route round it
sun_shade: Open in the middle; trees on the south and east edges shade the afternoon and morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is private or locked at night
